body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: `affected` excludes the owning package and its importers with `NO_DEPENDENCY_PATH_TO_DIRTY_UNIT` when the dirty path is unowned (rts, two findings: `//go:embed` asset and deleted Go file; each 1/2). Agreed and reproduced: changing `internal/gokernel/host-schema.json` or deleting `internal/testsupport/hostload.go` leaves the packages that fail to build or panic excluded with an affirmative reason, while a RUNNABLE advisory command over ~32 coincidental path-literal readers is emitted; `tools/gate-affected-select` selects them correctly. `Owns()` (`golang.go:89-90`) accepts `.go` only; `seed()` (`select.go:266-273`) never seeds the directory owner; readers run after traversal (`select.go:131-132`). Split: AFP-V0-004 and AFP-V0-021 specify UNKNOWN scope and no reader propagation, and no consumer may treat an exclusion as proof. Settles it: the owner decides whether the shipped verb must match the gate tool's rules (a)-(c). The chair's view: the reason string `NO_DEPENDENCY_PATH_TO_DIRTY_UNIT` on a unit that has a dependency path to a dirty path is wrong regardless of the spec, and AGENTS.md tells agents to run the selected units. Ticket V1-0230 is adjacent.
title: panel D7: `affected` excludes the owning package and its importers with `NO_DEPENDENCY_PATH_TO_DIRTY_UNIT` when the dirty path is unowned
